title: Prepare Site for TVC-governed HIL intake projection
coordination_rule: TVC retains exclusive deployment, protected-value consumption, execution-grant issuance, revocation, and runtime authority. Site assistance is non-authorizing and limited to sanitized projection, validation, and public-state boundaries.
remaining_upstream_crossings: successful hosted execution-grant proof run with inspected artifact
TVC-owned edge or serverless api/hil/ingress deployment
fresh lease consumption, replay refusal, and retirement evidence
activation gate evaluation against complete runtime evidence
remaining_site_crossings: import an authentic TVC receipt bundle after upstream proof and deployment
retain public readiness false until all activation evidence validates
site_parallel_safe_work: Verify incoming/hil source-object handling remains fail-closed
Validate commit-pinned TVC receipt bundles with exact hash and chain linkage
Reject protected-value disclosure, scope expansion, replay, invalid consumption, broken linkage, and authority escalation
Validate durable ingress receipts separately from participant-device fallback records
Preserve unrelated Site routes and deployments
coordination_checkpoints: TVC execution-grant proof artifact is retained
one valid grant is consumed exactly once and replay is refused
Site import validator accepts the authentic sanitized chain
public readiness remains false until activation gate passes
acceptance_criteria: Site holds no TV or TVC protected value
receipt projection contains hashes, identities, states, timestamps, scopes, and authority booleans only
participant-device fallback cannot be represented as durable submission
consumed, revoked, expired, unvalidated, replayed, or scope-mismatched grants cannot establish readiness
no public readiness claim occurs before authentic TVC deployment and execution evidence
no Site action grants runtime, execution, publication, release, or custody authority
claim_release_condition: One authentic commit-pinned TVC runtime receipt bundle validates after governed deployment; activation remains separately governed.
